title: ShieldBreakAlert
description: Alerts players when their shield breaks.
body:
# ShieldBreakAlert

Alerts players when their shield breaks.

## Features
- Detects shield break events.
- Plays sound and message.
- Configurable alert sound.
- Simple and lightweight.

## Command
- `/shieldalert reload`

## Permissions
- `shieldbreakalert.use`
- `shieldbreakalert.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
sound: ENTITY_ITEM_BREAK
message: '&cYour shield broke!'
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
